_comment: The `deposits` block of config.json — merge it into your node's config, do not use this file directly.
Every address here was read off the live staking app and verified on Base mainnet (chain 8453).
receivingAddress is the operator wallet callers send AIN or sAIN to. Replace it with your own.
vault.address is AI Network's staking contract, NOT an ERC-4626 vault. sAIN has asset() and looks like a
vault from a distance, but exposes no convertToShares; the conversion is one exchange rate on the staking
contract, read as AIN per sAIN in 1e18 fixed point. It has NO DEFAULT and the node refuses to start without
it, because a wrong one misprices every deposit for ever and nothing at runtime would reveal it.
The Base entry watches AIN. Add a second entry with isVaultShare true to also accept sAIN sent directly:
that token is already in share units and is credited without conversion.
confirmations may be omitted; defaults are 12 on Ethereum and 30 on Base. Raise them if you accept large
deposits and would rather wait than be reorganised.
